benefits.title: What an account gives you
benefits.body: A free account turns Cherenkov from a library into a study companion.
benefits.accessWithoutAccount: You can still access editorials, materials, the syllabus, and interactive visualizations without an account.
benefits.planner: Build a personal OSN study plan with subjects, chapters, and your target exam stage in one place.
benefits.progress: Track completed topics and review your progress so you always know what to study next.
benefits.practice: Save your place in editorials and interactive visualizations, then return without losing your context.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with. If an account exists, we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

errors.server: The server rejected the Google sign-in request. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong signing in with Google. Please try again.
